The source is decision #3 ("Compression approach: we're using gzip"), the only compression decision in the catalog. Nothing recorded replaces it.

One session transcript contains a "let's switch to zstd" message, but it was never recorded as a decision, so I left it out.

The first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead. I didn't re-read the file afterwards.
